activity.notes: Marcus Aurelius became Roman emperor on 7 March 161 and reigned until his death on 17 March 180. Lucius Verus shared imperial power until 169 and Commodus was elevated as co-emperor in 177, but Marcus's own imperial reign was continuous.

sources.title: Marcus Aurelius — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Marcus Aurelius as Roman emperor from 161 to 180 and notes his joint rule with Lucius Verus.

sources.title: Reign of Marcus Aurelius
sources.citation_text: The detailed reign chronology gives accession on 7 March 161 and death on 17 March 180.
